about: Native Basilisk NRLMSISE gtd7d density comparison at identical stored hourly states; no propagation or pass/fail assertions.

protocol.source: Installed AVS Lab Basilisk 2.12.0 native NRLMSISE gtd7d; pinned ERFA GCRF-to-ITRF and WGS84 gc2gd; immutable neutral-export epochs/EOP/space weather
protocol.comparison: Identical native gtd7d inputs except local solar time: raw UTC-hours plus longitude-degrees/15 versus modulo 24 hours.
protocol.rationale: HPOP computeNRLMSISE00 wraps mean local solar time. The frozen Basilisk adapter preserves the native unwrapped convention. The NRLMSISE source uses the rounded hourly angle constant 0.2618, so a 24-hour shift is not exactly periodic numerically.
protocol.frame: Stored GCRF position rotated to exported ITRF by pinned ERFA; WGS84 geodetic altitude and latitude.
protocol.epoch: Each row records its UTC epoch; exported TT elapsed seconds advance the split TT date for Earth orientation. These 2026 arcs contain no leap second.
protocol.switches: All native switches are 1: SI output, daily Ap, all variations enabled; gtd7d includes anomalous oxygen at every altitude.
protocol.limitation: Same-state hourly density measurements do not establish a propagated trajectory error, do not sample every integration midpoint, and do not replace recorded native midpoint density messages.
